title: Verification makes discovery matter
abstract: The existing research ecosystem in the United States often treats publication, particularly of new or positive results, as the primary marker of success. To move the scientific enterprise onto a better course, the US National Institutes of Health (NIH)—one of the largest public funders of biomedical research in the world—has launched a reproducibility and replication initiative grounded in a conviction that discovery and independent verification are inseparable pillars of science.
abstract_zh: 美国现有的科研生态往往将发表，尤其是新发现或正面结果，视为成功的主要标志。为使科学事业走向更佳轨道，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）——全球最大的公共生物医学研究资助机构之一——启动了一项可重复性与复制性倡议，基于发现与独立验证是科学不可分割的支柱这一信念。
